## Lindwurm (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
N Huge dragon  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +14  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 9, flat-footed 22 (+1 Dex, +14 natural, –2 size)  
**hp** 135 (10d12+70)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +8, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** corrosive blood; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +18 (2d6+9/19-20 plus grab), tail slap +17 (2d6+13)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** powerful tail, swallow whole (2d6+9 bludgeoning damage plus 4d6 acid damage, AC 17, 13 hp)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 29, **Dex** 13, **Con** 22, **Int** 3, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +21 (+25 grapple); **CMD** 32 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Improved Critical (Bite), Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Bite)  
**Skills** Perception +14, Survival +14  
**Languages** Draconic (can’t speak)  


**Special Abilities**


**Corrosive Blood (Ex)** A lindwurm’s blood can corrode metal on contact. If a creature damages a lindwurm with a piercing or slashing weapon made of metal, the creature’s blood deals 4d6 points of acid damage to the metal weapon (unlike most forms of energy damage, this damage is not halved when applied to a metal object, although it does still have to penetrate the metal’s hardness). The weapon’s wielder can halve the damage the weapon takes by making a successful DC 22 Reflex save. Creatures made of metal that deal slashing or piercing damage to a lindwurm with a natural attack take 4d6 points of acid damage (a DC 22 Reflex save halves this damage). The corrosive elements of the blood fade 1 hour after it leaves the lindwurm’s body or the lindwurm dies. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Powerful Tail (Ex)** A lindwurm’s tail slap is considered a primary natural attack and adds 1-1/2 times the lindwurm’s Strength bonus to damage.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or nest (3-5)  
**Treasure** double
